title: CommandGroupList
description: GET /api/commands/groups: one page of distinct commands. The number of matching groups is in the X-Total-Count response header.

key.description: sha256 of the trimmed command text, first 24 hex chars. Used in /api/commands/groups/{key}.

text.description: Attacker-typed text. Render as text only.

items.description: ATT&CK technique id, e.g. T1082 or T1110.001. Heuristic tag, not a confirmed technique.

techniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ids matched by the rule set in app/mitre.py (heuristic). Absent on rows stored before the MITRE backfill ran.
